case.cellStiffnessInterpretation: Cell stiffness is a separate catalog reference in the massless series approximation; lowerLink stiffness/damping describe the modeled spring-and-damper connection. No separate high-frequency cell state is modeled.
case.actuatorParallelDamperInterpretation: Any added damping above intrinsic2Ns/m is an external A-B viscous element, not a force-cell bypass.

scope: Every native10us sample from20ms before to200ms after bump entry; metric uses all400001 samples. Gate is held from its native100Hz history.
